> 第23章 到处捡钱（第1页）
陆昭菱看到这几个荷包就想起来了，这是陆小可怜给陆家人准备的礼物。
陆小可怜其实知道自己回到京城陆家之后不受欢迎，她也知道自己被丢在乡下十年有内情，但她一个人力量微弱，只想先跟他们暂时相处好。
等到在京城稳住脚跟，再慢慢查清楚当年的事。
但她在乡下本来也是被当牛做马，吃尽苦头，自然准备不了什么好礼物。
小荷包是她攒了好久的碎布头缝制的，里面装了她亲手做的绢花。另外还有三个是装了几颗石头。
是她在后山河里捡到的，非常漂亮的石头，想送给陆家三个小少爷。
但是，现在东西在陆昭菱手里了，自然不可能再送出去。
陆昭菱把那几块小石头倒在了桌子上，目光顿时就被其中两块墨绿色的小圆石吸引了过去。
简单来说，如果放在鱼缸里，鱼儿不会缺氧而死，如果放在绿植根部，绿植会长得很好！
而她现在也急需生机，生机有助于她修为尽快恢复。
陆昭菱没想到竟然还有这样的收获。
陆小可怜前几年因为老陆家的人想抢她的一个坠子，就在后山河边挖了个坑，把那坠子埋在那里了。
这次突然被接回京，她担心自己应付不了陆家人，那个坠子就没有挖出来，还藏在那里。
看来，她身体好一些之后还得回一趟乡下，把那个坠子拿回来。
“昨天我明明跟厨房的人说，小姐受了伤，要吃清淡滋补的食物，但是他们今天给的早膳竟然是这个！”
她把托盘端了过来，上面是一碟小酱菜，看着红彤彤，应该挺辣的，还有一个小拳头大的馒头，那馒头看着发黄，应该是用下等的面粉做的。
陆昭菱拿起来捏了捏，硬得很，估计是隔夜的了。
“你们的早饭呢？”她问。然后把馒头丢回碟上。
青音端了温水过来，也叹了口气，“小姐，奴婢刚找管家要细盐，要给小姐洗漱，他就给了一小瓶这个。”
她递过来一个小竹筒，里面盛着发黄的盐粒。
王府会有细鬃毛柳条，沾些细盐用来刷牙，京城一般人家都是这样的，只是用的东西品质略有差别，可像这种发黄的盐粒，那是家境不好的百姓才用的。
很明显，陆家就想在这些事上恶心陆昭菱。
“陆夫人说，陆大人为官清廉，两袖清风，府里要养这么多人不容易，东西都是拣着划算的用，吃穿也节省，让小姐别生气。”
想到刚才陆夫人说着这些话时那得意又挑衅的神情，青音牙痒痒。
陆昭菱站了起来，问青宝，“会编手绳吗？帮我穿起来。”

> Chapter 23 Picking up money everywhere (Page 1)
Lu Zhaoling saw these purses and remembered that they were gifts prepared by Lu Xiaomei for the Lu family.
Lu Xiaomei actually knew that she was not welcome after returning to the Lu family in the capital. She also knew that there was something wrong with being left in the countryside for ten years. However, she was weak on her own and just wanted to get along with them temporarily.
Wait until you have a firm foothold in the capital, and then slowly find out what happened back then.
But she was treated like a cow and a horse in the countryside and suffered a lot, so naturally she couldn't prepare any good gifts.
The small pouch was sewn from rags that she had saved for a long time, and it contained silk flowers that she had made by herself. There are also three that contain a few stones.
She picked it up in the Houshan River. It was a very beautiful stone and she wanted to give it to the three young masters of the Lu family.
However, now that the thing is in Lu Zhaoling's hands, it is naturally impossible to give it away again.
Lu Zhaoling poured the small stones on the table, and his eyes were immediately attracted to two small dark green stones.
To put it simply, if you put it in a fish tank, the fish will not die from lack of oxygen. If you put it at the roots of green plants, the green plants will grow well!
And she is in urgent need of vitality now, which will help her recovery as soon as possible.
Lu Zhaoling didn't expect such a gain.
A few years ago, Lu Xiaomei dug a hole by the Houshan River because someone from the old Lu family wanted to steal a pendant from her, and buried the pendant there.
When she was suddenly taken back to Beijing this time, she was worried that she wouldn't be able to cope with the Lu family, so the pendant was still hidden there without being dug out.
It seems that after she gets better, she will have to go back to the countryside to get the pendant back.
"Yesterday I told the people in the kitchen that the lady was injured and needed to eat light and nutritious food, but the breakfast they gave me today turned out to be this!"
She brought the tray over. On it was a plate of small pickles, which looked red and must be quite spicy. There was also a steamed bun the size of a small fist. The bun looked yellow and must have been made of inferior flour.
Lu Zhaoling picked it up and squeezed it. It was very hard. It must have been left overnight.
"Where's your breakfast?" she asked. Then throw the buns back on the plate.
Qingyin brought warm water over and sighed, "Miss, I just asked the housekeeper for fine salt to wash the lady, and he gave me a small bottle of this."
She handed over a small bamboo tube containing yellow salt grains.
In the palace, there will be fine-bristle wicker dipped in some fine salt for brushing teeth. This is what most people in the capital do, but the quality of the things they use is slightly different. But yellowing salt grains like this are only used by people from poor families.
It was obvious that the Lu family wanted to disgust Lu Zhaoling over these things.
"Mrs. Lu said that Mr. Lu is an upright and honest official. It is not easy to support so many people in the house. He only chooses things at the most cost-effective use and saves money on food and clothing. Please don't be angry, Miss."
Thinking of Mrs. Lu's proud and provocative expression when she said these words just now, Qingyin's teeth itched.
Lu Zhaoling stood up and asked Qingbao, "Can you knit bracelets? Help me put them on."
